name: RubicProxy routerCallNative executes an arbitrary whitelisted call
summary: RubicProxy.routerCallNative() forwards caller-supplied calldata to any address in availableRouters. USDC was on that list in both proxies (added by the admin to the first, set in the second's constructor), so the attacker passed USDC as router with transferFrom(user, attacker, amount) calldata and spent the approvals users had given the proxies.
notes: Both proxies are targets: the anchor drained approvals through each. The first got USDC as a router by addAvailableRouter after deployment, the second has had it since its constructor, so the second's deployment is the latest reset. Integrator fee settings only change fees, not feasibility.

Campaign from trace_filter of all calls the proxies made until their last use (third-party USDC transferFrom to a non-proxy). Three copycats kept the USDC; a fourth (0x2152fd37…, 100 USDC) was returned to its victim, a rescue. Other chains' proxies had no token among their routers.
